hooks.text: 化身灵魂绑定大地的不死Raid Boss，死亡只是下一次变强并开启新可能的循环。
hooks.excerpt: As the unkillable embodiment of chaos, death means nothing to you as your soul is permanently tied to this land of mortals! With each new life, you gain more power, and each cycle opens up new possibilities to grow stronger.
hooks.label: 证据原文片段

hooks.text: 在格子战场组合原初元素，探索18种元素交互并围绕偏好定制牌组。
hooks.excerpt: Discover all 18 possible tile interactions and tailor your build to your preferred style of play
hooks.label: 证据原文片段

hooks.text: Raid Boss拥有三个阶段与24种Boss机制，可选四种组合成个人化首领。
hooks.excerpt: As the Chaos Incarnate , you possess 3 Phases . The road to power means unlocking your latent "Boss Mechanics" . These mechanics work across distinct phases, with 24 unique powers attainable through in-game achievements . Combine up to 4 "Boss Mechanics" to craft your personalized Raid Boss .
hooks.label: 证据原文片段
